hook: Fish swap their way upstream past the bank folk, fill six-stamp passports, then Spawn for rewards and come home.
loop: Leap fish upstream, swapping them past bankside watchers for Stamps.
Six Stamps fill a passport; its next Leap makes it Spawn.
Spawns pay out rewards, then the fish comes home to replay.

growth.line: Mostly +1/+1 per Leap from Parr and bank folk; late, the Alder swallows each Spawning fish.

feel.early: Cheap shoves and Landlady passes stamp passports.
feel.mid: Passports fill; choose who Spawns and when.
feel.late: Laps, copies and Bradán's stored Spawn bursts.

stars.why: Swapped down each pass, she buffs a whole leaping column.
Forces a Spawn at any Stamp count and takes half.
Bankside carry that gains each Spawning fish's full stats.

card_short.u01: When played: shoves the nearest fish upstream one Leap.
card_short.u02: Leaps each fight, grows on every Leap; Spawn buffs fish.
card_short.u03: Bankside. Gold once a turn when a fish leaps past.
card_short.u04: Bankside. Buffs every fish that leaps past her permanently.
card_short.u05: End of Turn: buffs the next fish upstream; it Leaps.
card_short.u06: Leaps whenever another fish dies; Spawn summons three Fry.
card_short.u07: Start of Combat: back-row fish Leap and gain fight stats.
card_short.u08: Spawn: your other fish gain stats permanently.
card_short.u09: When played: Leap. Spawn: gain 3 gold.
card_short.u10: Start of Combat: this and every fish behind it Leap.
card_short.u11: Bankside. Buffs fish that Leap into your front row.
card_short.u12: Bankside. A fish leaping past Spawns now; he takes half.
card_short.u13: Repeats every other fish's Spawn text.
card_short.u14: Each Spawn also gives you a base copy, for triples.
card_short.u15: Spawning fish stay, clear Stamps, move to the Mouth, grow.
card_short.u16: A fish dies: fish downstream Leap and gain fight stats.
card_short.u17: Learns every Spawn text; his own Spawn fires them all.
card_short.u18: Your other fish earn 2 Stamps per Leap.
card_short.u19: Bankside. Gains each Spawning fish's stats permanently.
card_short.x01: 2/1 fish token; earns no Stamps, deaths still count.
card_short.x02: Printed rulings for Bradán, Little Jack, Kelt, Llyn Llyw, Redd.

builds.name: The Fish Ladder
builds.line: Kype sweeps a fish column past one Landlady, buffing each in turn.

builds.name: The Long Road
builds.line: Old Kelt keeps Spawning fish fighting; Little Jack and Bradán repeat Spawns.

builds.name: The Next Run
builds.line: Bear forces Spawns, Mother Redd copies them home into triples.

liked: Landlady sliding down to catch a whole leaping column; all three named her.
The Bear makes Spawning a choice at any Stamp count, not a wait.
worries: Watch: Mother Redd with the Bear makes a triple every turn or two.
Watch: Old Kelt, Llyn Llyw and Weir-Jumper loop Fry in fights, feeding the Alder.
changed: A full passport now Spawns on its next Leap, so you see it coming.
Old Kelt's kept fish clear their Stamps, so laps actually work.
Fish-Pass Trout now gives its leaping fish fight stats, so it earns a pick.
verdict: Fun 7.3, distinct 7.3, ranked second of three and called the most different; for players who love building swap combos.
